column7: - [ ] Settings → General → visibility Public - [ ] Settings → Collaborators → add `deco3500-team` - [ ] Settings → Features → Wikis on - [ ] Post the repo URL in team chat

column2: Push the cleaned repo (force push) and ask everyone to re-clone
column7: After the history clean-up: force push, make the repo public again, everyone deletes old clones and re-clones.

column2: Team call: lock domain statement, G1–G6 must-haves, hosting, session schedule
column7: Decisions to record in Stand-up Records: - [ ] Final domain statement (v4 or edit) - [ ] G1–G6: which are must-have for the tradeshow - [ ] Hosting: Render vs laptop + hotspot - [ ] Who runs which evaluation session - [ ] Confirm owners on this board

column2: Set up GitHub Projects board and add every issue
column7: Board columns: Todo / In progress / Done. Add all issues; set owner and due date fields.

column2: Paste WIKI pages from documents/wiki and resolve every [confirm]
column7: Pages: Home, Week 9 Stand-up, Stand-up Records, User Research, Evaluation Plan, Ethical Considerations, Design Process Overview. Upload documents/wiki/images. Search each page for `[confirm` and fix.

column2: Week 9 Stand-up page: confirm stand-up date and team notes
column7: Keep the honest 'written up after the event' note.

column2: Run v0.3 on a laptop + 2 phones (README demo) and log any bugs
column7: Follow README → Run it on a laptop. Walk through G1–G6 with two Cart Units. Open an issue per bug.

column2: Expo Cart Unit: test in Expo Go on iPhone and Android
column7: `npx expo install --fix` if the SDK doesn't match Expo Go. Test camera scan → compare, Ask home, Split Shop, Finish.

column2: Host the backend and test on uni Wi-Fi and a phone hotspot
column7: render.yaml is in the repo (New → Blueprint). Paste the hosted /dock link into README. Test from 3 devices on uni Wi-Fi.

column2: Pre-load 20–40 real products with shelf prices (one store)
column7: Use Dock → Product library. Barcode, name, size, compare category, shelf price, unit price, protein, sugar. Record the store and date observed.

column2: Build the physical Home Dock stand + 4 numbered housemate tokens
column7: Tablet or laptop in a kitchen-style stand. Coloured, numbered tokens (1–4) matching the screen. Photograph for the WIKI and poster.

column2: Build the Cart Unit mount for basket AND trolley handles
column7: Must fit a basket handle (basket shoppers found v2 too big). Photograph it in use.

column2: Optional: make tokens physical with a keypad or Makey Makey (keys 1–4)
column7: The Dock already selects a token when keys 1–4 are pressed.

column2: Recruit 2–3 share houses and 2 shopping pairs; book times
column7: Sessions Thu 15–Sat 17. Every member leads or co-runs at least one.

column2: Run household sessions H1–H3 (Evaluation Plan, Study A)
column7: Reset the house first. Observation sheet + counts + group interview. Add participants to the evidence register within 24 h.

column2: Run shop-pair sessions S1–S2 (store with permission, or simulated $25 shop)
column7: Study B script.

column2: Evidence register with participant IDs; fix all participant counts
column7: One ID per participant (R1-P01…, R2-, R3-, SH-, H1-P1, S1-P1). Poster and overview numbers come only from here. Label studio peers separately.

column2: Synthesise R4 findings (Q1–Q8) → list of v4 changes
column7: Fill Evaluation Plan → Results.

column2: v4 fixes from evaluation
column7: Only fixes the evidence supports. Note each change and its evidence.

column2: Poster content and A2 portrait layout
column7: Use documents/promo/poster-content-draft.md. Close-read, conference style, QR code to the repo.

column2: Send poster to print (A2 portrait)
column7: Check print-shop lead time first. If evaluation results aren't ready, print with prototype + research and present R4 results verbally.

column2: Pitch script; every member can deliver it (≈2.5 min)
column7: Use documents/promo/pitch-script.md. Each member rehearses the whole pitch once.

column7: E1, E3, E4, E5 and the revision log.
